title: Slumbering Beetle
move_pattern: Cycles between Snore (while has Slumber power) and Roll Out. Once Slumber power ends, repeatedly uses Roll Out.
notes: The monster starts asleep with Slumber and Plating powers. The move pattern is controlled by a conditional state machine that checks if the beetle still has Slumber power. While sleeping, it uses Snore (a do-nothing move). Once the Slumber power expires after 3 turns, it transitions to repeatedly using Roll Out. The Plating power is removed during the wake-up animation sequence.
